description: Construction of an AI Data Centre with 300MW Demand Utility Capacity and Car Parking, Landscaping, Roads, Access and Associated Works — Land to the northeast of Glenbervie Nursery, Stirling Road, Larbert

representations.notes: Deadline News reported 6,833 comments (6,820 public: 6,719 objections, 80 support) shortly after the 2 July 2026 consultation close; the portal showed 7,130 comments on 30 July 2026 as late submissions continued. STV reports the council accepts submissions after the statutory 21-day deadline and that a pre-determination hearing will be required before a planning committee/full council decision.

events.title: Scheme relocated from Plean (Stirling) to Glenbervie, Larbert; pre-planning application lodged
events.description: DCD reported Apatura moved its planned 300MW campus from agricultural land near Plean to land at Glenbervie Business Centre, Larbert, ~3 miles away, lodging a pre-planning application.
